title: Mathlib group lifting with explicit operation and adjunct formulas
statement: Let $A,B$ be categories with chosen finite products [def-weil-category-product], terminal objects $*_A,*_B$, and Cartesian braidings (canonical for the group construction and the single-functor transport). Write $U_A,U_B$ for the underlying-object functors. An abelian group object consists of an object with associative commutative binary operation, a unit from the terminal object and an inverse endomorphism satisfying the group laws as equations of morphisms. A commutative ring object has such an additive group structure and a second associative commutative binary operation with unit from the terminal object, distributing over the additive operation. Morphisms commute with all operations. For a finite-product-preserving functor $F:A\to B$, let $\lambda^F_{X,Y}:F(X\times Y)\to F(X)\times F(Y)$ be the canonical product comparison and $\lambda^F_*:F(*_A)\to *_B$ the terminal comparison. Let $L:A\to B$, $R:B\to A$ preserve finite products, and let $L\dashv R$ have hom-bijection $\Phi$, unit $\eta$, counit $\varepsilon$. There exist functors $L^g:\operatorname{AbObj}(A)\to\operatorname{AbObj}(B)$ and $R^g:\operatorname{AbObj}(B)\to\operatorname{AbObj}(A)$, strict equalities $U_BL^g=LU_A$, $U_AR^g=RU_B$ with components $e^L,e^R$, and an adjunction $L^g\dashv R^g$ with hom-bijection $E$, such that for $F=L,R$ and its lift $F^g$ (interchanging the source and target categories for $R$), $e_X\circ m_{F^gX}=F(m_X)\circ(\lambda^F_{X,X})^{-1}\circ(e_X\times e_X)$, $e_X\circ q_{F^gX}=F(q_X)\circ(\lambda^F_*)^{-1}$, $e_X\circ i_{F^gX}=F(i_X)\circ e_X$, where $m,q,i$ are group multiplication, unit, inverse. For every group morphism $f:L^gX\to Y$, $e^R_Y\circ U_A(E(f))=\Phi(U_B(f)\circ(e^L_X)^{-1})$. The lifted unit $u$ and counit $v$ satisfy $R(e^L_X)\circ e^R_{L^gX}\circ U_A(u_X)=\eta_{U_AX}$ and $U_B(v_Y)\circ(e^L_{R^gY})^{-1}\circ L((e^R_Y)^{-1})=\varepsilon_{U_BY}$. For every $\alpha:LU_AX\to U_BY$, there exists $f:L^gX\to Y$ with $U_B(f)\circ(e^L_X)^{-1}=\alpha$ if and only if there exists $g:X\to R^gY$ with $e^R_Y\circ U_A(g)=\Phi(\alpha)$.

Its content is supplied directly by Functor.mapCommGrp and Adjunction.mapCommGrp, as recorded in the existing abelian-group Mathlib leaf.
